required_steps: identify the repository, branch, commit, and authoritative environment
declare the requested scope and affected capability before editing
compare claims with source, database catalog, migration history, and live deployment evidence when applicable
run focused checks and record exact commands and outcomes
preserve unresolved conflicts as CONFLICT or UNVERIFIED
block production when required evidence is missing, conflicting, or unverified
prohibited_claims: declared in source is not verified online
a successful build is not proof of a production deployment
an artifact or design file is not proof of a provisioned service
never record credentials, private connection strings, personal business data, or trade-secret calculations

when_true: every artifact must include a valid SHA-256
every required deployment_evidence flag must be true
production_evidence_rule.unverified_non_dependencies: May be retained as evidence, but must not be used or represented as production capability.
